name: Principal Axes Theorem
text: If $A$ is a symmetric $m\times m$ matrix with eigenvalues $\lambda_1,\lambda_2,\ldots,\lambda_m$, then the quadratic form $q_A$ can be written, after an orthogonal change of coordinates $\yvec=Q^T\xvec$, as $$ q_A(\xvec) = \lambda_1y_1^2 + \lambda_2y_2^2 + \ldots + \lambda_my_m^2. $$
